images.alt:
Two star-filled silhouettes in profile on a dark, star-speckled ground, backlit by a luminous galaxy. On the right a tall woman with her hair in a bun, head bowed down, and on the left a small boy with tousled hair looking up at her, their hands almost touching. Both figures are dark silhouettes but filled with tiny stars and cosmic speckles, as if made of the sky itself.
The background is an expansive night sky with a bright milky way nebula at the center, deep indigo and midnight blue fading to a glowing white-lavender core with soft lavender, periwinkle and faint magenta nebular clouds. Countless stars and star bokeh are scattered throughout, two crescent moons float in the sky, one large in the upper left and a smaller one mid-left. The lighting is ethereal and backlit, with a soft halo around the figures from the central nebula.

#aiart #promptshare #caturday
Title: "The Storm Watcher's Vigil"
Style: Gothic Romanticism meets magical realism, influenced by the atmospheric paintings of Caspar David Friedrich, the dark fantasy aesthetics of Edward Gorey, and contemporary dark academia visual culture
Prompt in ALT

images.alt:
A sleek black Bombay cat with copper eyes sits upon an ornate Victorian Gothic windowsill during a stormy night, but the scene is transformed into something magical. Rain outside the arched window doesn't fall downward but rises upward toward a lightning-filled sky that contains glimpses of other realms—floating castles, sea creatures swimming through air, clocks melting over rooftops. The cat's silhouette is rimmed with silver light, and its shadow on the floor has taken on a life of its own, stretching and forming shapes of wings or perhaps another creature entirely. Inside the room, candles burn with flames of unusual colors—purple, teal, gold—and their smoke forms intricate patterns in the air. Antique books on nearby shelves have pages that flutter as if read by invisible hands, and a crystal ball on a pedestal reflects not the room but a sunny garden.
Style: Gothic Romanticism meets magical realism, influenced by the atmospheric paintings of Caspar David Friedrich, the dark fantasy aesthetics of Edward Gorey, and contemporary dark academia visual culture
Composition: Framed through the architectural element of the Gothic window, creating layers: interior room in foreground, cat at middle ground on windowsill, fantastical exterior beyond window; strong verticals from window architecture contrasting with chaotic energy of the storm
Lighting: Dramatic high-contrast lighting with the primary source being lightning flashes from outside (cool white-blue) contrasted with warm interior candlelight; flickering quality suggested through varied illumination across the scene
Adjectives: Mysterious, atmospheric, gothic, bewitching, tempestuous
